title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Striker
moral: Trusting your teammates makes you stronger together.

"We need a striker," said the robot.
{{NAME}}'s eyes lit up with surprise.
"I have never played with robots before," he said.
"You will be great," the robot beeped.
